setup.intro_langue:
Which language should the bot reply in? "Automatic" follows each member's own language.

**Currently**: {langue}
setup.intro_logs:
Pick the channel where moderation logs are sent (sanctions, AutoMod, tickets…). You can split logs by type later with /setlogs.

**Currently**: {salon}
setup.intro_staff:
Members with this role can use /warn, /warns, /unwarn and /historique without any extra permission.

**Currently**: {role}
setup.intro_modules:
Turn the bot's modules on or off. The General module always stays on.

{liste}
setup.intro_jeux:
You can limit games to some channels (default: every channel).

**Currently**: {salons}
setup.recap_suite: To go further: /config (all settings), /setlogs (logs split by type), /setticket (tickets).
setup.expiree: /setup assistant ended (10 min without activity). Run /setup again to continue: the choices you already confirmed are kept.
setup.ancienne_session: Another /setup was opened: this one is closed.
setup.arrivee: 👋 Thanks for adding the bot! An administrator can run **/setup** to configure it in a few steps (language, logs, staff role, modules).
